title: March 10, 2026 — Video of Kīlauea episode 43 lava fountaining
place: Halemaʻumaʻu crater, Kīlauea summit, Hawaiʻi Volcanoes NP, Hawaiʻi (filmed from the south rim)
notes: Two side-by-side lava fountains (north and south vents) 0-~7 s, then a closer view of one fountain 7-14 s. Best seconds 0-6 (twin fountains). Source is 1392x782 at 119.88 fps, upscaled to 1920x1080 and resampled to 30 fps at normal speed. Original audio kept; it sounds like field audio (wind/fountain roar), but nobody has listened to it yet, so check it before using. No people, no logos.
fact_en: During episode 43 (March 10, 2026), USGS estimated the maximum fountain heights at at least 1,300 feet (400 meters) from both vents.
